notes: Primary source is the official Poly/HP "Data Sheet: Poly Studio X70" (©2021 Plantronics/Poly, mirrored at netstorage.ringcentral.com and assets.ringcentral.com; original poly.com PDF URL now redirects). The X70 is an all-in-one 4K video bar (camera + speakers + mics) for large rooms, not a traditional AV source/switcher — closest available category/type in the allowed enum is "source"/"Media source"; it also natively performs video-switching (HDMI in to 2x HDMI out with touch-display pass-through) and network video-conferencing endpoint functions. Not rack-mountable (desktop/wall/VESA-mount soundbar form factor), so rackUnits omitted. Exact rear-panel port labels (e.g. "HDMI IN", "HDMI OUT 1/2") could not be confirmed since the interactive docs.poly.com/support.hp.com hardware-port diagrams are JS-rendered and not fetchable in this session; port names below use the datasheet's plain descriptions. HDMI/USB/Ethernet versions are stated explicitly in the datasheet (HDMI version itself is not stated — omitted grade rather than guess; content resolution up to 4K/UHD is supported over HDMI in per the datasheet's "content video resolution" list, but no HDMI spec version, e.g. 2.0, is given). USB-A ports are stated as "3.0" (mapped to usb-5g, the grade for USB 3.0/3.2 Gen1 5Gbps); USB-C port version is not stated by Poly (used for PC/USB passthrough) — grade omitted for USB-C. Ethernet ports are explicitly "10/100/1G" (eth-1g). Power: device ships with an external "auto sensing" power supply/brick (100-240V AC in, 12V/5A DC out per the separately-sold replacement PSU 875M7AA) connecting to the device via a DC barrel jack; exact barrel dimensions not published by Poly. The 3.5mm audio in/out, second USB-A, and second RJ45 are all confirmed via the same datasheet ("Other Interfaces" and "Network" sections).
